title: Cosmic hero
description: Opening screen on the starfield: a very large title, then one column of text that comes in after it, and the limb of a planet rising at the bottom with an orbital sunrise and two craft gliding along their orbit. Stacks on narrow screens.
instructions: Put two or three short texts in the lead slot, the first one in the style lead (the situation or the question), the next ones plain: they come in one after the other.
